feature.summary: On web and desktop (hosted web), 'Customize' makes your own editable copy of an installed, turned-on plugin's skills, then turns the original off. 'Edit plugin' changes the copy. In chat, asking to build a plugin or skill can show a draft card with a Save button. Copy and edit are the only fork path found.

purpose.what_it_does: Copies the skills and companion files of an installed plugin into a new personal plugin named '<name> (custom)', installs and enables it, turns the original off, and opens the editor. Also lets a person create a plugin by form or by asking in chat.
purpose.why_it_exists: People want to change a plugin's skills without losing the original (brief: S54.27, S54.28, S54.35). Skill authoring is on by default and can be switched off by a server setting (apps/web/lib/services/user-skill-authoring.ts:5-12).
purpose.who_uses_it: Signed-in web and desktop-hosted users who write or tune skills.
problems_solved: A published plugin is almost right but needs one skill changed.
Keeping the original available to turn back on.
use_cases: Customize a built-in pack and edit its 'summarize' skill.
Ask the assistant 'build a plugin that drafts release notes' and press 'Save plugin' on the card.
Press 'Edit plugin' on an authored plugin and save changes.

where_to_find_it: Web: Settings > Customize > Plugins > installed plugin > button 'Customize' with hint 'Make your own copy of this plugin and edit its skills.' (packages/ui/ui/src/directory/PluginDetailView.tsx:911-940; constants.ts:454-455).
Web: authored plugins show 'Edit plugin'; creation form titled 'Create a plugin' (constants.ts:429,449).
Web chat: a card with 'Save plugin' and 'Save as a skill' buttons after a build request (apps/web/features/chat/components/PluginDraftCard.tsx:29-30).
Desktop (public Electron app): the hosted web app; the draft card is offered on the 'web' and 'desktop' chat surfaces (apps/web/lib/server/tools/plugin-draft-tool.ts:43).
Mobile: no copy or edit; the card titled 'Customize' only switches skills on or off (apps/mobile/src/features/plugins/PluginDetailScreen.tsx:549).
CLI, VS Code, Chrome: not available. For the CLI this is a recorded decision (doc: docs/decisions/2026-09-27-founder-decisions.md D-2026-09-28-29 lists plugin customize and S54.27 for CLI).
prerequisites: Signed in; the plugin installed and turned on (the Customize button shows only then) (apps/web/features/directory/services/plugins-directory.ts:998,1035).
Skill authoring not switched off (AGI_USER_SKILL_AUTHORING not '0').
Workspace gates for both 'plugins' and 'skills' pass (apps/web/features/plugins/server/directory/install-gate.ts:14,26-37).
The plugin has at least one skill (customize.ts:161).
screens_and_controls: 'Customize' button; confirm dialog 'Customize <name>?' with body 'You get your own copy with the same skills and files, which you can edit. The original is turned off so your chats use your copy; you can turn it back on from its page.' and confirm 'Make my copy' (constants.ts:456-459; DirectoryPanel.tsx:669-686).
'Edit plugin' button and form with Name, Description and Skills, button 'Save changes' (constants.ts:429-452).
Draft card buttons 'Save plugin' and 'Save as a skill'; saved text 'Saved as a plugin. Its skills are on in your chats.' (PluginDraftCard.tsx:29-35).
journey: Open an installed, turned-on plugin that has skills.
The server copies skills and files into '<name> (custom)', installs it turned on, and turns the original off.
The editor opens on the copy; change the skills and press 'Save changes'.
To go back, open the original page and turn it on again.
Chat path: ask for a plugin or skill; the assistant calls the draft tool; press 'Save plugin' on the card.
feedback_and_outputs: The page switches to the copy; the original shows as off (useDirectoryAdapter.ts:1688-1707; DirectoryPanel.tsx:669-686).

Errors: 'Install and turn on this plugin before you customize it.' (409), 'This plugin has no skills that can be copied.' (422), 'Skill authoring is not available.' (404) (apps/web/app/api/plugins/customize/route.ts:47-62; customize.ts:39; user-skill-authoring.ts:8).
If a copy already exists the same copy is returned with created false (customize/route.ts:62-66).
settings: AGI_USER_SKILL_AUTHORING: server switch, on unless set to 0 (apps/web/lib/services/user-skill-authoring.ts:5-12).

working: POST /api/plugins/customize: CSRF, rate limit, gate for plugins and skills, then customizePlugin; returns 201 {entryId, created: true} or 200 with created false (apps/web/app/api/plugins/customize/route.ts:23-80).

customizePlugin resolves the original (user marketplace entry, built-in registry pack, or directory plugin), validates every skill draft, copies companion files up to a limit, stores an 'authored' source with key '<key>-custom', installs it turned on, and turns the original off (apps/web/features/plugins/server/directory/customize.ts:84-119,154-198; apps/web/lib/services/plugin-owned-source-service.ts:289-312).
The Customize button is offered only for an installed and enabled plugin that is not itself authored (apps/web/features/directory/services/plugins-directory.ts:998,1035).

Edit: GET and PUT /api/plugins/authored/[entryId] load and save an authored plugin; POST /api/plugins/authored creates one, both gated by refusePluginInstall with authorsSkills (apps/web/app/api/plugins/authored/route.ts:92; apps/web/app/api/plugins/authored/[entryId]/route.ts:85,114-115).

Plugin-creation assistant exists: a chat tool 'plugin draft' is offered on web and desktop surfaces when the message matches build/create/write plus plugin/skill, streaming is on, and authoring and both workspace gates pass (apps/web/lib/server/tools/plugin-draft-tool.ts:21-22,43; apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts:1237-1257,5590-5594).

Draft card saves to POST /api/plugins/authored or the skills API (apps/web/features/chat/components/PluginDraftCard.tsx:47-60); a stored draft can be re-read by GET /api/chat/conversations/[id]/plugin-drafts/[toolCallId] (apps/web/app/api/chat/conversations/[id]/plugin-drafts/[toolCallId]/route.ts:33-93).
incomplete: The server does not check 'installed and on' itself: 409 means the plugin could not be resolved for the user; a not-installed directory plugin yields 422 'no skills that can be copied' because installed skills are empty (apps/web/features/plugins/server/directory/customize.ts:84-119,160-161). The 'turn on first' rule is enforced by the button only.
The draft says a separate fork action is missing; confirmed: copy is the only fork path.
disconnected_or_disabled: Skill authoring can be switched off by AGI_USER_SKILL_AUTHORING=0; then customize, create and the chat draft tool are refused or not offered (user-skill-authoring.ts:10-18; request-processor.ts:5591).
not_available: Mobile: no copy, edit or create.
CLI: not offered, by decision (doc: docs/decisions/2026-09-27-founder-decisions.md lines 462-468).
VS Code and Chrome: none found.
Chat draft card on mobile, CLI, VS Code: not offered (surface set is web and desktop only, plugin-draft-tool.ts:43).

established.statement: A user can customize an installed plugin (edit its skills or content) (S54.27).
A user can fork a plugin into their own editable copy (S54.28).
The product helps a user build a plugin with an assistant (S54.35).
The CLI does not offer plugin customize.
Skill authoring is refused when the authoring setting is off.
An agent never destroys user data; the copy leaves the original in place and only turns it off.

acceptance_criteria: Customize on an installed, enabled plugin with skills creates one new installed plugin named '<name> (custom)' and turns the original off.
Pressing Customize again returns the same copy (created false) and creates no second one.
With AGI_USER_SKILL_AUTHORING=0 the customize route returns 404 'Skill authoring is not available.'
A plugin with no skills returns 422 with the message 'This plugin has no skills that can be copied.'
Edit plugin saves changes that appear in chats using the copy.
Asking 'build me a plugin for release notes' on web shows a card with 'Save plugin'; saving installs it on.
The Customize button is absent on a turned-off or authored plugin.
inferred: [inferred] The server should reject a customize request for a plugin that is installed but off, matching the message 'Install and turn on this plugin first'.
[inferred] The fork (S54.28) and customize (S54.27) rows describe one action; the brief lists both with the same code.
proposed: [proposed] Merge S54.27 and S54.28 into one item in the brief.
[proposed] Move the 'installed and on' check into customizePlugin so the API matches its error message.
[proposed] Rename the mobile skill card so it is not also called 'Customize'.

steps.what_happens: Browser posts {pluginId} or {entryId} to /api/plugins/customize with CSRF.
Server rate-limits, requires authoring on, applies the plugins and skills workspace gates.
Server reads the original's skills and companion files, validates each skill draft, stores the copy as an authored source, installs it on, and turns the original off.
Server records an audit event and returns the new entry id; the browser refreshes and opens the editor.
Chat path: the chat service offers the draft tool; the chat model fills it with name, description and skills; the card appears; Save posts to /api/plugins/authored.

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: Copy and edit use no model. The chat draft assistant relies on the chat model that serves the turn, which must support tools (toolsCapable) and streaming; which model that is comes from the normal chat routing and is not decided here (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts:1226-1233).

access_and_usage.permissions: CSRF, rate limit, authoring enabled, workspace feature gates 'plugins' and 'skills' (install-gate.ts:14,26-37). Org plugin policy is not evaluated for a copy because pluginKeys is empty (customize/route.ts:39-42).
access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: plugin-installation-write 20 per minute (apps/web/lib/rate-limit.ts:519; customize/route.ts:28). Companion files per skill are capped by SKILL_COMPANION_MAX_FILES (constant not read). The draft tool allows 1 to PLUGIN_DIRECTORY_MAX_SKILLS_PER_INSTALL skills (plugin-draft-tool.ts:28-39). Chat turn metering for the draft message is outside this feature.
access_and_usage.model_compatibility: Draft assistant needs a tool-capable model and a streaming request (request-processor.ts:1226-1233). Copy and edit: not applicable.
access_and_usage.local_mode: Copy, edit and the draft card are Managed Cloud only (web and desktop-hosted). Whether the Tauri Local settings can copy a plugin was not examined. The CLI has no customize by decision.

scenarios.name: Copy a plugin
steps: Install and enable a plugin with skills on web.
scenarios.expected: A plugin named '<name> (custom)' is installed on; the original shows off; the editor opens.

scenarios.name: Second press
steps: Open the original again and press Customize.
scenarios.expected: The same copy opens; no second copy exists.

scenarios.name: Authoring switched off
steps: Set AGI_USER_SKILL_AUTHORING=0 on a test server.

scenarios.name: No skills
steps: Customize a plugin that has only commands or agents.
scenarios.expected: 422 'This plugin has no skills that can be copied.'

scenarios.name: Chat draft
steps: On web, ask 'build a plugin that turns notes into release notes'.
scenarios.expected: A plugin is saved and on; the card reads 'Saved as a plugin. Its skills are on in your chats.'

scenarios.name: Original turned back on
steps: After copying, open the original and turn 'Enabled' on.
scenarios.expected: Both plugins are on; no data lost.

corrections.what_the_code_shows: The stored plugin keeps original.name; only the source name gets ' (custom)' and only the key gets '-custom'.
corrections.correction: The copy is a plugin with the original's name and key '<key>-custom', stored under an authored source named '<name> (custom)'.

corrections.claim: Customize button is offered only for an installed and enabled plugin that is not itself authored (plugins-directory.ts:998,1035)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Line 998 sets customizable: installed && enabled with no authored check; only line 1035 (the user-entry path) adds && !authored.
corrections.correction: Customizable means installed and on; the not-authored exclusion applies only to user marketplace entries (line 1035).

corrections.claim: Chat draft tool offered on web and desktop when the message matches build/create/write plus plugin/skill, streaming on, authoring and both gates pass
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Surface set is web+desktop. The intent regex has more verbs (make, draft, design, turn, update, change, edit). It also needs toolsCapable, ambientToolsAllowed and a non-temporary chat, which the page omits from the rule.
corrections.correction: Offered on web and desktop surfaces for non-temporary, streaming, tool-capable turns whose message matches build/create/make/write/draft/design/turn/update/change/edit near plugin or skill, with authoring and plugins+skills gates passing.

missing_facts: The draft tool is withheld for temporary chats (!params.isTemporary) and requires toolsCapable plus ambientToolsAllowed: apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts:1226-1233.
The rate limit is failClosed (requests are refused if the limiter fails): apps/web/lib/rate-limit.ts:519-522.

Customize works on built-in registry packs even when not installed (resolved via getPluginRegistryEntry and listManagedPluginSkillsWithFiles), and turning off uses setWebPluginEnabled for them, so the 'installed first' rule is not just button-enforced for that path: apps/web/features/plugins/server/directory/customize.ts:100-109.
